targets.query:
from(bucket: "my-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "SY4527")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.slot == "12")  // Filter by slot
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vreq")  // Use exact field name
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != -999)
  |> last()  // Get the last value for each series
  |> yield(name: "last")
